title: chrysothamnus bloomeri var. angustatus
intro: Chrysothamnus bloomeri var. angustatus, commonly known as Gray rabbitbrush, is a shrub native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The plant is known to have various health benefits, including its use in traditional medicine to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory properties. Its therapeutic actions include reducing inflammation, fighting oxidative stress, and showing antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Gray rabbitbrush include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
